result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mainly related to content being cut off at screen edges and inconsistent card sizing.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with both the image and text truncated.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll container to properly clip content or add a visual indicator (like a partial fade) to show there's more content to scroll to.

issues.description: The pizza promotion card at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off by the navigation bar, showing only a partial image with no text or details visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure proper spacing/padding above the bottom navigation bar so content isn't awkwardly truncated, or add a scroll fade effect.

issues.description: Category filter pills ('Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') have a partially visible pill cut off at the right edge, suggesting horizontal scroll but without clear visual cue.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient effect at the edge of the scrollable filter row to indicate more options are available.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated/incomplete without ellipsis styling, making it look like a text rendering error rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Use proper text-overflow ellipsis CSS or ensure text wraps/truncates with visual indication (...) rather than hard cutoff.
